# Inner World Counseling Services, PLLC

> Virtual (telehealth) trauma therapy practice serving North Dakota, Minnesota, Ohio, and Utah. Led by Deirdre Kuvaas, a licensed clinical counselor specializing in EMDR and Cognitive Processing Therapy for high-functioning adults with trauma, anxiety, and complex PTSD.

## About the practice

- **Provider:** Deirdre Kuvaas, LPCC (Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor) in North Dakota, Minnesota, and Ohio; LCMHC (Licensed Clinical Mental Health Counselor) in Utah; LADC (Licensed Alcohol and Drug Counselor) in Minnesota
- **NPI:** 1881112399
- **Practice:** Inner World Counseling Services, PLLC
- **Format:** 100% telehealth / online only
- **States served:** North Dakota, Minnesota, Ohio, Utah (primary markets: North Dakota and Minnesota)
- **Website:** [https://deirdrekuvaas.com](https://deirdrekuvaas.com)

## Specialties

- Trauma and PTSD, including Complex PTSD (C-PTSD)
- Anxiety and high-functioning anxiety
- People-pleasing, perfectionism, and burnout in high-achieving adults
- Substance use / addiction

## Treatment approaches

- EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing)
- CPT (Cognitive Processing Therapy)
- Person-centered, trauma-informed care

## Professional affiliations

- EMDRIA (EMDR International Association) member
- Verified by Psychology Today
